_note: Tier A reference data (verbatim catalogs/lookup tables) extracted from IP2025 top-level XML. Read-only source: C:\Program Files\IP2025. Dimensions in inches (imperial) and mm (metric) unless noted.

CasingProgram.note: default hole-size for each casing OD (drilling program telescoping defaults)

FTOutputCurves.note: output-curve catalog for the Formation Testing (wireline pretest / MDT-RFT) module: drawdown/spherical/radial permeability & mobility, P*, hydrostatic before/after, flowrate. Scope: 'later' (pressure/mobility).

UnitConfig.note: maps IP curve-type name to unit category

IP_Petrel_Unit_Mappings.note: unit-string normalisation IP->Petrel used on Petrel export/import (density, sonic, caliper, resistivity, GR, velocity).
